description: This file defines the GrantFactory class, responsible for creating and managing OAuth2 grant objects within the league/oauth2-client library. It includes methods for setting, retrieving, default registration, and validation of grant instances.

classes.name: GrantFactory
classes.description: A factory class that manages OAuth2 grant objects, allowing for registration, retrieval, and validation of grant types.

methods.name: setGrant
methods.description: Registers a grant instance with a specific name in the factory's registry.

methods.name: getGrant
methods.description: Retrieves a grant instance by name, registering a default grant if not previously registered.

methods.name: registerDefaultGrant
methods.description: Creates and registers a default grant class based on the provided name, converting the name to a class name.

methods.name: isGrant
methods.description: Checks if a given class is a subclass of AbstractGrant, indicating a valid grant type.

methods.name: checkGrant
methods.description: Validates that a given class is a proper grant; throws an exception if not.
